--- revoke_execute_on_all_functions_in_named_schemas.sql
REVOKE EXECUTE ON ALL FUNCTIONS IN SCHEMA inventory, accounts FROM ROLE consumer

--- AST
&ast.Revoke{
  Privilege: &ast.ExecutePrivilegeOnAllFunctionsInSchema{
    Execute: 7,
    Table:   -1,
    Default: -1,
    Schemas: []*ast.Path{
      &ast.Path{
        Idents: []*ast.Ident{
          &ast.Ident{
            NamePos: 42,
            NameEnd: 51,
            Name:    "inventory",
          },
        },
      },
      &ast.Path{
        Idents: []*ast.Ident{
          &ast.Ident{
            NamePos: 53,
            NameEnd: 61,
            Name:    "accounts",
          },
        },
      },
    },
  },
  Roles: []*ast.Ident{
    &ast.Ident{
      NamePos: 72,
      NameEnd: 80,
      Name:    "consumer",
    },
  },
}

--- SQL
REVOKE EXECUTE ON ALL FUNCTIONS IN SCHEMA inventory, accounts FROM ROLE consumer
